english: I missed dinner.\nI won't make it till morning…….
(Something smells good……)
Hmm, did I make too much?\nWhat do I do…….
……Huh?\nW-what's wrong?
*Grrrowl*……
Is your stomach……?\nThen eat this!\nHere, here, here~!
Mmgh!?
Thank goodness……\nYou were collapsed here;\nyou really surprised me.
It looked like you'd collapsed from hunger,\nso I fed you Rena's special homemade cookies.
I see……\nThank you, Rena-san.
S-so, um…….
Um, Rena made sweets for everyone, but……\nI think I made too much.
If you'd like, um……\nwon't you eat a little more?
Of course, gladly, if I'm good enough.
Really?\nYay!
So the good smell was sweets.\nIs it okay for me to have this much all to myself?
Yeah!\nSeeing you eat them so happily\nmakes Rena happy too.
Sweets this delicious,\nI'd want to eat them every day.
Really?\nThen even if I make too much every day,\nI don't have to worry.
But this is a bit much…….
I really did make too much……\nHauu…….
I made them all fired up, but\nsome people say no\nbecause they'll get fat…….
Ahaha, I see.\nThey were delicious, thank you for the meal.
From now on, when I make sweets,\nI'll bring some over.
Rena always wanted a boy friend\nwho'd eat lots of sweets like this.
So today I was a little\nhappy, maybe……\nDo it again for me?
Yes, of course.
Well, Rena should get going.\nGood night.
They were delicious……\nbut maybe I ate a bit too much…… *slump*.
(I wonder if Rena-san will bring sweets again today.\nI'm looking forward to it)
Will she come……?
(Th-that's…… Rena-san?\nWhat she's holding is…… a h-hatchet!?)
Is someone there……?
……Nobody here, it seems.
Good…… nobody can see\nme like this…….
Rena's fun time…… hehe.
Hah, hah…… what was that all about……\nI have a bad feeling about this…….
Not here either……\nWhere is it……?
I can't find it……\nI can't find it!
(Rena-san, who ARE you!?)
……!\nWho's there!?
……What are you doing in a place like this?\n……kana?
R-Rena-san…….
Oh?\nMaybe you're interested in treasure hunting?
What's wrong, why that shocked face…….
Ah, this hatchet?\nI use it to clear away rubble\nand stuff in the way.
Ahaha, did I startle you\na bit, kana?
Treasure hunting……?
Yeah, treasure hunting!\nI heard there are lots of mysterious ruins\nnear town.

So I go out digging,
find cute things,
and take them hooome!
That's the plan~.
(I don't really get it, but I guess\nshe has that kind of hobby)
I'll help.\nIt could be dangerous for a girl alone.
Do your best.
Yeah, but it's pretty tough……\nI'd be happy if someone\nhelped out, kana……?
If I'm good enough.
Really?\nHauu, I'm so happy.
But I haven't found any\nruins yet.
So right now I'm still searching!\nIs that okay?\nWill you search with me?
Of course.
Good.\nI was really hoping\nto make more friends.
Then please take care of me from now on.\nI'm looking forward to it.
Sorry to keep you wai~ting.
Starting today, we're exploring for the treasure mountain-\nlet's do our best together~.
I prepared all sorts of things for this day.\nUm…….
First…… of course, this!　The hatchet!\nAnything in the way gets a whack, whack with this.
(Honestly, that's scary……)
Also a first-aid kit, and lunch.\nHow's that?
I-I think it's good.\nEspecially the lunch…….
Ahaha, you're a glutton.\nBut I'm glad you're looking forward to it.
Then, let's head out.\nActually I have no leads, but…….
But if we go too far from town,\neveryone will worry,\nso maybe searching nearby is best?
I thought it might be needed,\nso I gathered some information on my own.
Huh, really?\nNice going!
……Wow, this is super helpful.\nWith this we'll definitely find it!
Alright!　Then let's search for the treasure mountain-\noff we gooo!
Hehe, this is like a picnic.\nFun!
Ah, of course we have to be careful\nnot to get hurt.
But thinking a man is here\nif anything happens\nis a little reassuring, kana……?
I'm not confident, but……\nI'll do my best, so rely on me.
Yeah, Rena will be careful too,\nbut if anything happens, I'm counting on you.
Leave it to me.\nI'll protect you, Rena-san.
……K-kind of like a knight.\nThat was a little cool.
Ah…… wait.\nThis sound is…….
It's the babbling of a river.\nThere was such a big river near town.
No bridge in sight……\nwe can't cross like this.
Yeah, can't be helped.\nLet's eat lunch and head home today.\nIf we're too late, everyone will worry.
Next time let's go around and search the other side.\nHaving a goal is kind of fun!
Yay~!　We got past that river from last time!
A great adventure is surely waiting up ahead.\nI'm getting excited!
……But first, lunch?\n'No fighting on an empty stomach'-\nMii-chan said so too.
You always eat it so happily,\nit makes Rena happy.
Ah, you can't scarf it down like that.\nChew properly.
Ahaha, it reminds me of school.\nI used to feed the younger kids like this.
Still, Rena-san, you really do love exploring.
It's not exploring I like,\nit's cute things!
And here, we'll surely find super rare cute things\nthat don't exist in our world!
(According to Mion-san and the others,\nRena-san's 'cute things' are all just junk, though……)
If I find one, it'll be a lifetime treasure……\nHauu…… *slurp*.
(She's looking forward to it so much,\nI'd like to help if I can)
We'll definitely find it.\nIf anyone can, it's you, Rena-san.
Yeah!\nRena will do her best~.
I'll find it.\nFor Rena-san.
Th-thanks~.\nBut Rena wants to search together, kana.
Alright, let's resume exploring.\nI feel like we're about to find something.
The path's getting rough.\nMaybe townspeople don't come this far?
Ah……\nwhat's that?
It looks like a building entrance.\nCould that be the ruins……?
Waaah…… it really is an entrance!\nA real-life ruins!
Excited, excited…… let's go!
It's huuuge……\nIs this the ruins the townspeople were talking about?
Inside…… hmm, too dark to see.\nWe need light.
This is turning into a more serious expedition than I thought.\nI'm getting a little nervous, kana…….
How about we head back and re-prepare?
……Yeah, maybe that's better.\nI'll get properly ready by then!
I can't stop being excited.\nWe're like an expedition team!
……Mountains.
……River.
Hauu!\nWelcome!
You weren't followed, kana?　kana?
I-I think it's fine.\nBesides, it's night, everyone's asleep.
No way~!　It's a secret place\nwe finally found.
We'll find an amazing treasure\nand surprise everyone.
Alright, let's head in right away!
Wo~w…… so this is what it looks like.
Light really makes a difference.\nWe can explore like this!
But it's dim…… watch your step.
This kind of thing is exciting.\nLike sneaking into school at night…….
Is that kind of thing a little boyish?\nBoys like exploring, right?
Not really.\nDangerous stuff isn't my thing.
I see.\nThen you were probably a girl in a past life.
I do like it, if anything.\nIt gets me excited.
Yeah!\nIt's fun.
Hehe, my treasure hunting was always alone,\nso right now I'm having so much fun.
At this rate, I hope we find the treasure…….
What kind of treasure are you looking for, Rena-san?
Anything's fine.\nSomething you work hard to get,\nyou can treasure.
But…… still,\ncute things would make me happy!\nHauu~.
Ahaha…… ouch?
A-are you okay!?\nWow, you've got a huge bump.
A dead end……?\nWe can't go further.
Ugh…… but Rena won't give up!\nNext time we'll conquer this place!
That's it for today!\nLet's head home.
You came.\nThanks, as always.
Today let's conquer that dead end.
How are we going to conquer it?
It's fine, I came prepared.\nFor now, let's go!
……Here.
I borrowed tools from Satoko-chan.\nTie this rope like this…….
Done!\nHow's that?　kana?
Looks sturdy; seems doable.
Then let's cross!\nRena'll go first.
Heave, heave…….
Be careful.
Yeah, I'm fine.\nRena's surprisingly good at-ah!?
Ah, watch out!
Ugh…… ow ow ow…….
But it's fine,\njust scraped…… huh?
Guh, whew…….
Ah!　Did I- land on you!?\nA-are you okay?
I'm…… fine…….
You don't look fine!\nYour face is pale!
I might…… be done for…….
Hauu~,\nwas Rena too heavy…… hau hauu…….
For Rena's sake, this happened…….
A-anyway, I'll get you outside!\nBear with it a little.
For now, with this……\nI did first aid, but…….
Are you okay…… does it hurt……?
Ugh…… I'm sorry……\nit's my fault…….
I-I'm fine!\nLook, it's just a light scrape.\nI can move already, so let's resume exploring.
No, you can't push yourself…….
Let's head home today?\nI'll walk you back, okay?
If you say so, Rena-san…….
Yeah…… I'm really sorry…….
Sorry for calling you out suddenly.\nActually, there's something important…….
Um, well…… actually…….
I think…… I'm going to stop\nthe treasure hunting…….
Huh?　You were looking forward to it so much.
……Yeah, but.\nRena's been reflecting.
Last time, I got you hurt…….
No matter how fun treasure hunting is,\nhurting someone is no good…….
Rena was only thinking about her own fun,\nand forgot something important…….
I'm fine, really.
……Thanks.\nYou're kind.
Honestly.\nGood thing I'm tough.
Hehe…… you're cheering Rena up.\nI'm happy.
Really, you're done?\nWon't you regret it?
I don't think I'll regret it.
Because……\nRena already found a precious treasure.
Huh, when……?
It's something you can't see.\nNot something with a shape, but something real.
Huh, you want to know?\nReally, kana…….
Um, well……\nhow do I say this kind of thing…….
Hauu!\nI'm too embarrassed to say it!
……??\nWhat on earth is wrong with Rena-san?
Café SHC……?\nM-my feet are moving on their own…….
Hauu, take me- I mean,\nwelcome~!
R-Rena-san!?　Is that you!?
Yeah…… how is it?　Does it suit me?
Of course, you're super cute!
Really!?　Good…….
Rena loves cute things, but\nI never knew being told I'm cute\nwould make me this happy.
So, um, well……\nyou've done so much for me…….
Today I wanted to thank you\na lot…….
I prepared some hospitality,\nso I hope you enjoy yourself.
You said Rena's cooking was delicious,\nso I made lots. Will you eat it?　kana?
All this for me……?\nI-I'm moved!
Delicious, delicious……\nEverything is amazingly delicious!
Hauu…… if you praise me that much\nI'll get embarrassed.
So, um, there's one more request…….
Um, well…… today, will you……\ntake Rena home?
Whaaat!?
How about it……?　No good……?
No good?　Not at all…….
U-understood!　I'm a man too!\nI'll take you hooome!
Good…… then, here I go?
Huh?
Hawawawawawa, hauu!
Hehehe, how dirty!
Ababababa, huh!?
That kind of shamelessness is……\nn-n-n-no good!
Fugogogo, stop!?
Wh-where is this……?\nHuh, what happened to me?
Geez…… you were half-asleep and\nsuddenly tried to hug Rena…….
So I accidentally lashed out,\nbut maybe I overdid it…… sorry?
(Th-that's…… so everything until now was…… a dream?)
Oh no, I have to head home!\nEveryone's worried, right?
(That's right……\nwe'd decided to stop the treasure hunting)
Too bad we couldn't find the treasure.
No, about that……\nI found it, so it's fine.
It's, um…….
Memories!\nThe memories of having fun treasure hunting together\nare Rena's treasure!
Things break someday,\nbut memories stay.\nSparkling, shining in my heart forever.
So that's that, how about it?　No good?
……I think it's good.\nIf you enjoyed yourself, Rena-san,\nI have nothing to say.
Good!\nIt was fun\nthanks to you being with me!
Let's definitely go treasure hunting again sometime!\nPromise!
